assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
Intermittent palpitations and dizziness require continuous rhythm capture to detect intermittent arrhythmias
Symptomatic events may not be captured on intermittent evaluation
Symptomatic events may be reported as chest discomfort
The clinical indication note supports that Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (93229) is medically necessary
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied
The service was rejected under reason code PR-204
The diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Coverage determinations are based strictly on the terms of the active policy
The service falls outside the defined coverage parameters
The patient has a right to appeal the denial decision
